_meta.purpose: ISO/IEC 27701 privacy risk templates: the failure modes the PIMS controls exist to prevent. frameworkTag 'ISO27701', each with a LINDDUN classification.
_meta.origin: Moved verbatim from the inline `iso27701RiskTemplates` array in prisma/seed.ts (2026-11-08), so production receives it: prisma/seed.ts is never run on a deploy.
_meta.deliveredBy: scripts/seed-risk-templates.ts on every container start (scripts/entrypoint.sh), and prisma/seed.ts in dev, both through prisma/risk-template-fixtures.ts.

templates.title: Processing Without a Valid Lawful Basis
templates.description: PII is processed for a purpose that has no documented lawful basis, breaching the PIMS conditions for processing.

templates.title: Unfulfilled Data-Subject Rights Request
templates.description: An access, correction or erasure request is missed or answered late because no rights-handling process is in place.

templates.title: Unlawful Cross-Border Transfer
templates.description: PII is transferred to another jurisdiction without an established transfer basis or safeguards.

templates.title: Unmanaged Sub-processor
templates.description: A sub-processor handles PII without an agreement or disclosure to the customer, breaking the chain of accountability.

templates.title: PII Retained Beyond Purpose
templates.description: PII is kept past its retention period or not de-identified when the processing purpose ends.
